title: Berserk weapons and the Black Sword Greed
text: The Lords of the Mortal Sins: Black Axe of Sloth, Black Gunblade of Envy, Black Spear of Vanity and the Seifort Holy Sword each have three forms (opened at mastery levels 3 and 6), a technique, a Lord's decree at mastery level 8 and a named drawback explained when you first bind the weapon. The Black Chakrams are a fifth, plain weapon. Each Lord weapon is one of a kind. Techniques: Sloth every 8 s (hits up to 8), Envy 3 s (one target, 14 base), Vanity 4 s (12 base), Chakrams 3.5 s (9 base), Seifort 5 s (16 base, x1.5 on the undead). The Black Sword Greed devours the Existence Points of what it kills (it absorbs 15% by default) and opens one of its 8 forms at each tier: 0, 2,500, 10,000, 35,000, 100,000, 300,000, 750,000 and 2,000,000 stored EP. Its gains are capped at +200 health, +60 attack and +30 armour. Server files: nusmp-lords-server.toml, nusmp-sinweapons-server.toml, nusmp-greed-server.toml (damagePercent 100 = as listed). Take a skill and its weapon away with /multiverse sin purge <sloth|envy|vanity|chakrams|holy|all> (remove only takes the skill).
